THE PRASHANSANEEYA SEVA VIBHUSHANAYAAND THE PRASHANSANEEYA SEVA PADAKKAMA

IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the President has been pleased to award the Prashansaneeya Sewa Vibhushanayaand the Prashansaneeya Sewa Padakkama to the Naval Personnel specified in the Schedule hereto.

By His Excellency’s Command,

Eng. KARUNASENA HETTIARACHCHI,

Secretary,Ministry of Defence.Colombo,04th April 2016.

Annex ToC of N’s Letter No. Dna/Medal/17/2015Dated 09 th March 2016
